Paragraph: "Earlier when we were in hermitage, on hearing this bird's call, dear Seetha used to call me to listen, and she herself was highly cheerful at this bird's calls...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hearing a specific bird call triggers happy memories of past times spent with Seetha at the hermitage.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama reminisces about past joyful moments with Seetha to cope with her present absence.
Outcome/Resolution: Nostalgic memories bring both sweetness and painful longing.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Loneliness: Missing Spouse, Yearning for Past Companionship

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Smriti (Memory/Nostalgic recollection of cherished shared moments)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Memory serves as a spiritual bridge connecting past bliss (Sambhoga) with present yearning (Vipralambha), keeping love alive through remembrance.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Nostalgic recall triggered by sensory stimuli (birdsong), which evokes fond memories of a loved one while sharpening current grief.
